findings.title_text: AIS SFT rows are not available to tie against this high-value register
limits_text: The AIS reader used for this engagement loads Parts B7/B3/B4 only, not B2 (SFT) -- by that reader's own design, not a gap in this test alone.
ask_client_text: Supply the AIS Part B2 (SFT) detail export, or confirm the AIS reader should be extended to read it.

findings.title_text: s.269ST limb (c) (transactions relating to one event or occasion) cannot be checked from books
limits_text: An 'event or occasion' (e.g. one wedding covered by separate catering and decoration contracts with the same party, GN 56.11) is a fact about the world, not a ledger entry; no books signal can group transactions by it, in either direction (receipts or payments).
ask_client_text: Ask whether any party in the party-day/single-transaction rows above relates to one event or occasion with other transactions, in cash, not otherwise captured.

findings.title_text: s.194N non-filer band: whether the assessee filed returns for the three preceding assessment years is not a books fact
limits_text: If the assessee filed NO return for all three assessment years immediately preceding this one (whose s.139(1) filing time has expired), the lower non-filer band applies (2% from ₹20 lakh up to ₹1 crore, 5% above ₹1 crore) instead of the ordinary/co-operative threshold above -- return-filing history is not visible in these books and is never assumed either way.
ask_client_text: Confirm return-filing status for the three assessment years immediately preceding this one.

findings.title_text: s.194N: whether the co-operative-society (₹3 crore) or ordinary (₹1 crore) threshold applies to this recipient is not known
limits_text: s194n_recipient_type was not supplied (or not recognised) for this engagement, so which of the two thresholds above applies to this assessee as RECIPIENT of its own cash withdrawals is stated as a limit, never assumed either way.
ask_client_text: Confirm whether the assessee is a co-operative society for s.194N purposes.
